name: 13904 · Binghamton, NY
findings: ZIP 13904 (Binghamton) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13904 (Binghamton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 13904 (Binghamton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.
